constraints: real required-lane DB tests, no Prisma mocks

findings.summary: findings.ts invalid-select cluster -> raw 500 on core findings endpoints and evidence link/unlink
findings.root_cause: Finding has no linkedEvidence/description/findingType/provisionalFlag columns and Evidence has no relatedFindingId/visibility column; the service selected phantom fields, causing PrismaClientValidationError -> raw 500.

fix.approach: Select only real columns. Persist linked evidence in the real Finding.metadata.linkedEvidenceIds JSON. Derive the API DTO fields from real columns: description<-summary, findingType<-deriveFindingType(impactArea), linkedEvidence<-metadata, provisionalFlag<-(status==='provisional'). link/unlink use a single concurrency-safe finding.update and keep the audit event; dropped the phantom Evidence.relatedFindingId write. supersedeFinding.create writes only required real columns.

cases: OLD phantom linkedEvidence select throws on a real DB (defect-class proof)
getFindingDetail returns mapped DTO, no raw 500
link then unlink evidence persists via metadata, no raw 500 (real audit event, FK satisfied)

findings.summary: owner/dashboard db.KPI typo claimed to 500 every GET /api/owner/dashboard
findings.audit_theory: Generated delegate is db.kPI; db.KPI is undefined; undefined.findMany() throws 500.
findings.disproof: src/lib/db.ts db is a $extends-ed Prisma client behind a lazy Proxy. Runtime testing against a real DB shows the extended client exposes BOTH KPI and kPI as working delegates on both the cold/deferred path and the hot/fast (post-init, production) path. db.KPI.findMany() returns rows with no throw after getDbInstance() sets globalForPrisma.prisma.
findings.why_audit_erred: Earlier '[V]' rested on static grep casing counts and reading generated class.ts; never runtime-tested; missed Proxy + $extends tolerance of the exact model name KPI.

product_change.note: Speculative db.KPI->db.kPI edit reverted; product left unchanged per 'fix only if tests prove a real defect'.

cases: real client exposes BOTH KPI and kPI delegates on the fast path (disproves the audit theory)
the dashboard KPI query (db.KPI, as the route runs it) returns the workspace KPI - no raw 500
